newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold in 3 for 1 share split.
newsitem.headline: Ahold in 3 for 1 share split.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Wednesday it would split its shares on a three for one basis in July.
On March 6, Ahold announced it planned to split its stock effective July 21 of this year.
"This way, the stock will be more in line with the level at which most of the U.S. retail companies trade on the US stock exchanges," Ahold said in a statement.

It said it intended to replace each current share, with a nominal value of 1.25 guilders, with three shares of 0.50 guilders nominal value, raising its authorised capital to account for the extra 0.25 guilders.
